response.justification: Candidate is an experienced full-stack/backend software engineer with broad language exposure, but lacks the core mandatory requirements for this role: no significant recent hands-on C++ development (only a brief stint in 2014-2015), no Windows platform experience, no SQL Server/Oracle expertise, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure at all.
strengths: 10+ years of solid software engineering experience across multiple domains
Demonstrated strong CS fundamentals with TDD, CI/CD, and craftsmanship practices
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (under a year, a decade ago) and far below the 5-10 years required
No evidence of Windows platform development; career is centered on Linux/web/cloud stacks
Zero domain exposure to fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking; no SQL Server/Oracle experience

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income/investment banking domain knowledge
No Windows platform or SQL Server/Oracle experience
